_doc: Consistency-tier policy (user design 2026-07-07). Every constant here is DECLARED JUDGMENT, tunable without code. Provenance notes inline. Probabilities in the engine are exact hypergeometrics; only these parameters are opinion. Calibration practice: each test build, compare computed tier vs the user's judgment and adjust.

core_weights._doc: Exponents of the multiplicative CORE (they sum to 1). Geometric on purpose: consistency is conjunctive — a weak link drags the whole deck; wincon access dominates per the user's thesis.

turn_targets._doc: The turn by which each function must be online — the main judgment constants (Magic-argumentable, unlike a bare multiplier). RAMP per the user's table rule: anything that brings mana, INCLUDING land-search like Cultivate (an extra land that turn).

route_strengths._doc: Win-route quality by class (user refinement: reaching an auto-win infinite is STRONGER than reaching a value wincon like Toxrill). Multiplies the route's assembly probability inside Q_wincon = 1 - prod(1 - P*s). Utility combos are value, not win routes.

velocity._doc: Cards seen by turn T: 7 + T + expected DRAW sources seen * yield. The yield (extra cards a draw engine nets once seen) is the model's one mechanistic assumption.

bonus._doc: Additive, small, capped — things that help but must not define (a zero here never nukes the deck). GC deliberately LOW per the user (good cards, not that important; the consistency-relevant GCs already score as SEARCH/DRAW).
